# Receipt contracts (Geo-Grapher to the Librarian)

What each Geo-Grapher receipt must carry, and the Librarian step that consumes each field. A field with no consumer would be dead; a consumer with no field would be guessing. Proposed and unaccepted; none of these fields exists in today's receipts except where the as-is column says so.

## Applying a folder group (`graph-building:receipt`)

| Field | As-is | Consumer in the Librarian | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|
| snapshot_id | returned today | `librarian/to-be/folder-review:markstale` | records which snapshot the folder's decision produced |
| parser_version | not returned | `librarian/to-be/folder-review:markstale` | a change of version means every entity may have changed |
| parse coverage, with each unparsed file and its cause | logged as parse_failures_json; status still complete | `librarian/to-be/folder-review:oraclecov` | judges degraded coverage against the caller's tolerance |
| changed_entity_ids: added, changed, deleted | not returned | `librarian/to-be/folder-review:markstale` | marks the notes and claims citing a changed entity as stale, for the Oracle's recheck |
| counts | returned today | `librarian/to-be/ingestion:ledger` | reconciles the folder's ledger |

## Publishing a paper (`paper-import:receipt`)

| Field | As-is | Consumer in the Librarian | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|
| document_id | not returned (a count only) | `librarian/to-be/paper-publication:pubreceipt` | identifies the published paper |
| link to the source's identity | not returned | `link` in this pack, stored by the Librarian's Core | a citation follows it (`librarian/to-be/cite-graph:resolve`) |
| claim and concept counts | not checked | `librarian/to-be/paper-publication:dpubok` | refuses an empty paper graph for a multi-page paper |
| the active database and its previous snapshot | returned (previous_paper_database) | `librarian/to-be/source-enrichment:oracle` | audits the publication with the source's receipts |
